homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field; the capture's finding notes it (CAP-1-03). Card 6 is the homonym's: Luddite Labs, a software company in San Diego, whose About page (B6, fetched) reads 'Luddite Labs is empowering the next generation of software developers. We curate knowledge in software engineering and seamlessly deliver it into your workflow. Our AI-powered tools help developers spend more time creating software solutions and less time debugging and maintaining code.' T names it as 'an unrelated commercial software entity named Luddite Labs that builds AI-powered developer tools', which the page bears out. It is a distinct entity, never a sense of the hub's name. The plural is also used for the hub itself by one post AI Weekly embeds ('a really helpful resource from Luddite Labs at @dairinstitute', F31): a variant of the hub's name in reception, not the homonym. 'Luddite Lab' and 'Luddite Lab Resource Hub' are the hub's names, or the Lab's and its hub's (open block).
